subject: Typography & Computer Applications
instruction: Explain the pedagogical scope, core concepts, and assessment objectives for ICT Skills - IV in CBSE Class 12 Typography & Computer Applications.
expected_response: Under CBSE Class 12 Typography & Computer Applications (817), Unit-3: ICT Skills - IV covers fundamental foundational principles aligned with NEP 2020 competency-based learning framework. Learners are evaluated on conceptual understanding, problem-solving application, and analytical rigor.
